actions: Oct 2: a new video ad (10.1.26 Flexible Ad VID Winner creatives) was launched and started running the same day.
Oct 2: the older image ad (Flexible Ad IMG Winner creatives) was turned off.
Oct 6: the paused $9.50 tox ad set for returning visitors was turned back on and renamed with the relaunch date.

campaigns.campaign_name: KS/MM- DCT- LEAD-La Bella Sea Girt-$.9.50 + Free Consultation/ Facial Analysis- CBO

insights.creative: All five ads carry one message: 'Smoother Skin Starts with One Appointment', tox at $9.50 per unit with a free consultation and skin analysis, 'one of 15 available spots'. The video ad brought 3 of the 5 Meta leads on $72.52. The returning-visitor ad and the Sep 23 image ad brought 1 each. Worth trying a video that opens with 'No pressure. No guesswork.' from the longer ad copy, because video is earning most of the leads and every ad now opens the same way.
insights.doing: 3 leads reached the CRM this week at $45.33 each, compared with 4 at $36.15 the week before, on $136.00 of spend. At this budget the weekly count has moved between 3 and 8 for eight weeks, so the numbers are too small to call a trend.
insights.look_into: Meta recorded 5 leads but only 3 reached the CRM, so 2 are worth tracing. The week before the gap was 1, so we recommend checking that every lead form entry is being passed to the CRM.
insights.next: We recommend leaving the offer and the current ads unchanged for one full week now that the ad set for returning visitors is back on, then comparing CRM leads and cost per lead against this week.
